title: Chapter 1199 - 17 Fu Xu Heavenly Venerate (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1199 - 17 Fu Xu Heavenly Venerate (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1199: Chapter 17 Fu Xu Heavenly Venerate (Seeking Subscription)

As the leader of the twelve Heavenly Venerates dispatched by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Red Flame Venerable is certainly focused on competing for the treasure trove.

He wouldn’t sacrifice the opportunity to refine the treasure trove’s ’core’ just to accommodate Lin Yuan.

But in choices that aren’t critical, he plans to lean slightly toward Lin Yuan.

"Is that the newly emergent first-class treasure land?"

Lin Yuan looked far into the distance at the winding mountain range, where the power of time was chaotic, faintly revealing a vast world.

Each first-class treasure land is located in relatively opposing space-times, and only when it nurtures the first batch of wonders will it connect with the outside world, which is the so-called emergence of the treasure land.

"The ’core’ of a first-class treasure land is probably between one hundred and two hundred, and these cores merge with the land itself, making it very difficult to locate them quickly."

Lin Yuan thought to himself: "So among the twelve Heavenly Venerates dispatched by the major ancient countries, at least a few must excel at seeking ’cores’.

In the twelve Peak Venerables of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Venerable Hengyang excels in search methods.

"Let’s wait for a while; once the other ancient countries’ Heavenly Venerates arrive, we can go in."

Red Flame Venerable glanced at several distant spots, where space-time slightly twisted, indicating the presence of ancient country Heavenly Venerates.

"After entering the treasure land, disperse as much as possible to search for the treasure land’s ’core’. Once found, immediately notify me and Guanglie."

Red Flame Venerable emphasized that discovering the treasure land’s ’core’ isn’t the end; the most crucial part is refining and guarding it, which requires strength.

Venerable Guanglie’s special Chaos Power path, with thirty-three avatars, each close to the original body’s strength, is the most suitable Heavenly Venerate to guard the treasure land’s ’core’.

After speaking, Red Flame Venerable sat cross-legged, as did the other Heavenly Venerates.

Lin Yuan focused his mind, keeping a distant watch on the new treasure land while using the remaining mental power to practice and comprehend.

...

The twelve Heavenly Venerates of Da Ling Ancient Country also waited patiently, led by Spirit Prison Venerable, whose terrifying strength made him an extremely ancient Heavenly Venerate of Da Ling Ancient Country.

At this moment, Spirit Prison Venerable’s eyes were like two endless deep prisons, gazing distantly at the winding mountains.

The Chaos Power path evolved by Spirit Prison Venerable was in his eyes.

Spirit Prison Venerable’s eyes are two prison worlds named Spirit Prison, where even Peak Venerables would be suppressed for a time.

"Spirit Prison, how do you feel? Any confidence?"

Beside Spirit Prison Venerable, Linggan Venerable Sage asked.

"It’s still too early to talk about confidence." Spirit Prison Venerable shook his head, "The Venerates from Da Fu Ancient Country have yet to arrive."

Da Fu Ancient Country, also one of the six major ancient countries, is unlike the other five as it was the very first ancient country that emerged in this source world, with its ancestor being the first time life.

Da Fu Ancient Country is unfathomably deep, with two out of the five thirteen-tier ancestors from the five major ancient countries coming from Da Fu Ancient Country.

Among the six major ancient countries in the source world, while they appear to be competing, Da Fu Ancient Country holds the most transcendent position.

Besides the Da Fu Ancestor, it is due to the terrifying Heavenly Venerate-level powerhouses of this ancient country.

No matter in quantity or strength, they surpass the other ancient countries.

"Da Fu Ancient Country..." Linggan Venerable Sage also felt the pressure.

He understood Spirit Prison Venerable’s meaning.

If Da Fu Ancient Country dispatches its strongest Venerates, Spirit Prison Venerable naturally wouldn’t have much confidence.

"Except for Da Fu Ancient Country, surely for the other four major ancient countries, Spirit Prison you shouldn’t have any problem." Linggan Venerable Sage continued to ask.

"The other four major ancient countries..."

Spirit Prison Venerable glanced at the locations occupied by the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, Xuanyin Ancient Country, Thunderclap Ancient Country, and Barbaric Wilderness Country’s Venerates, saying nothing.

Based on past performance, Spirit Prison Venerable naturally has confidence.

However, in the competition for a first-class treasure land, each major ancient country typically employs some hidden weapons, making it uncertain.

...

On the Xuanyin Ancient Country’s side.

The twelve Peak Venerables quietly observed the Heavenly Venerate-level powerhouses from other ancient countries.

"Da Ling Ancient Country actually dispatched Spirit Prison Venerable? That’s quite troublesome." Su Yin Heavenly Venerate looked gravely at the location occupied by Da Ling Ancient Country.

Among the top Peak Venerables of various ancient countries, Spirit Prison Venerable is definitely the most difficult.

It’s not so much about Spirit Prison Venerable’s killing force, but rather his eyes, capable of trapping powerhouses at the Peak Venerable level.

In regular times, such a method isn’t much, as a Peak Venerable’s strength can break free; it’s just a delay.

However, within the treasure land, the ordinary refining of the treasure land’s ’core’ requires precisely that bit of time.

Imagine a Peak Venerable painstakingly discovering a treasure land’s ’core’, just ready to refine it.

But Spirit Prison Venerable traps them in the Spirit Prison within his eyes, and by the time they break free, the treasure land’s ’core’ has been refined.

The many Peak Venerables of Da Ling Ancient Country also moved in for reinforcement.

It would certainly be extraordinarily frustrating.

"Spirit Prison Venerable’s two Spirit Prisons are indeed troublesome, but not unbeatable. Even if he traps them, among the seventy or eighty Peak Venerables of the six great ancient countries, how many can he really capture? Surely, he won’t be able to withstand them all?"

Earth Yin Venerable commented.

This time, among Xuanyin Ancient Country’s twelve Peak Venerables, there are four regarded as top-tier Peak Venerables, including Su Yin Heavenly Venerate, Earth Yin Venerable, and two others.

"Still need to be cautious."

Su Yin Heavenly Venerate remarked; no matter what, Spirit Prison Venerable is undeniably one of the most formidable among the numerous top-tier Peak Venerables.
